outlook: Grains closed higher Friday on fresh export business. January soybeans settled up 12 1/2 cents at $12.31 1/2 (up nearly 38 cents on the week) after USDA flash sales of 134,000 tonnes to China and 120,000 tonnes to Vietnam, though weekly export sales of 1.155 million tonnes were a four-week low. December corn gained 3 cents to $4.45 1/2 on a 303,800-tonne sale to Mexico and marketing-year-high weekly sales of 2.88 million tonnes, while December Minneapolis spring wheat rose 4 cents to $6.26 3/4 (up 10 3/4 cents on the week) and Chicago wheat gained 9 cents despite marketing-year-low wheat export sales. ICE January canola closed up C$5.90 at C$783.20 per tonne; NOPA's October crush figures are due Monday.

news.title: Soybeans Post Friday Gains Following Export Announcements
Corn Firm into the Weekend as Export Business Picks Up
